title: Create Dashboard Layout Structure
description: Implement the main dashboard layout with sidebar navigation, header with logout functionality, and main content area using Next.js App Router structure
details: Create `/app/dashboard/layout.tsx` with a responsive layout structure including: sidebar for navigation (placeholder menu items), header with user info and logout button, main content wrapper, and footer. Use CSS Grid or Flexbox for layout structure. Implement logout functionality that clears session cookies and redirects to sign-in page. Style with dashboard-specific CSS classes that can be extended later.
test_strategy: Test layout responsiveness across different screen sizes, verify logout functionality clears session and redirects properly, ensure layout structure accommodates future content additions

title: Create Static Data Structure and Loader
description: Set up the data.json file with sample marketing analytics data and create utility functions to load and process this data
details: Create `/app/dashboard/data.json` with realistic marketing dashboard data including metrics like page views, conversion rates, traffic sources, campaign performance, and user demographics. Create a data loader utility function that reads and processes this JSON data, handles error cases, and provides TypeScript interfaces for the data structure. Include sample data for charts, tables, and key performance indicators typical in marketing dashboards.
test_strategy: Verify JSON structure is valid, test data loader handles missing files gracefully, ensure TypeScript interfaces match data structure, validate sample data represents realistic marketing metrics

title: Build Dashboard Main Page with Key Metrics
description: Implement the main dashboard page that displays key marketing metrics and performance indicators using the static data
details: Create `/app/dashboard/page.tsx` that loads data from data.json and displays key marketing metrics in a grid layout. Include components for: KPI cards showing metrics like total visitors, conversion rate, revenue; summary tables for top performing campaigns or traffic sources; placeholder areas for future chart integrations. Use semantic HTML structure and CSS classes that align with the dashboard theme. Implement proper loading states and error handling.
test_strategy: Test data loading and display functionality, verify metrics are correctly calculated and formatted, ensure responsive layout works on different screen sizes, test error handling when data is unavailable

title: Implement Dashboard Styling and Theme
description: Create comprehensive CSS styling for the dashboard including theme colors, typography, and component styles
details: Create `theme.css` with dashboard-specific styling including: color scheme suitable for data visualization (professional blues, greens for positive metrics, reds for alerts); typography hierarchy for headers, metrics, and body text; component styles for KPI cards, tables, buttons, and navigation elements; hover states and interactive feedback; consistent spacing and layout patterns. Ensure styles are scoped to dashboard area and don't conflict with global styles. Include CSS custom properties for easy theme customization.
test_strategy: Test visual consistency across all dashboard components, verify theme colors provide good contrast and accessibility, ensure styles don't leak to other parts of the application, test hover and interactive states work properly
